missSuffix.direction: Y=max(0,Y), unordered Y becomes zero, equal negative zero retained. Normalize XYZ using original RSQRTSS and one float32 Newton step.
missSuffix.sceneBoundary: Normal atmosphere path after the scene query misses; cheap-fog and surface-hit paths remain separate.

display.normalTransfer: Hardware linear-to-sRGB write. The viewport display transfer must remain enabled.

scope: Original supplied executable and complete disassembly evidence. Prepared miss suffix execution is independently checked in docs/probe-miss-native-check.json. No original scene/GPU/OS image parity claim.
